description: Tray-resident Windows tool that edits the focused input field of any app in an embedded Neovim
notes: Run 'anywhere-nvim' once; it stays in the tray. Ctrl+Alt+E edits the focused input field.
Neovim and the Moralerspace Argon HW font are bundled; nothing else needs to be installed.
Scoop does not register an autostart entry. Add a shortcut to shell:startup yourself,
or use the setup.exe from the release page, which offers a sign-in autostart task.
Local config lives outside the Scoop app directory and survives updates:
'scoop uninstall anywhere-nvim' does not remove them; delete those folders manually.
